title: Historical Reference Texts for Non-European Mathematics: LaTeX and Translation Drafts
description:
Focused reference-text page for the non-European mathematics side of the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This is not a separate competing corpus; it is a smaller download slice of the consolidated non-European/multilingual release for contextual texts used to compare terminology, biography, geography, bibliographic references, and historical framing.

Status at a glance. [########--] 13 reader/index PDFs present; [######----] working drafts for checking and continuation; [----------] not a proofed critical edition.

Provenance. This page is derived from the current consolidated non-European mathematics release. The source ZIP contains filtered TeX/source artifacts for this focused reference-text slice; the complete as-received raw provenance archive is preserved on the consolidated record. The workflow collects source scans and reference texts, converts them into TeX drafts, checks them into readable PDFs, and publishes source artifacts for inspection and correction.
version: 2026-05-28 current corpus release; clearer public title and relationship notes
notes: Focused reference-text slice of the consolidated non-European/multilingual mathematics corpus. The consolidated record is the main entry point; this page exists for smaller direct downloads of contextual reference texts.
